_about: Synthetic job-ad bodies for scripts/build_seed.py. Each seeded role is matched to the first template whose `match` regex hits its lower-cased title (`fallback` by track otherwise), and its description and the five must-haves on its evidence strip come from here. Placeholders: {company}, {title}, {years}. Hand-written; no real employers, people or ad text.

templates.about: {company} builds software that customers run in production on day one, and its forward deployed engineers are how that happens.
responsibilities: Embed with customer teams to understand their workflows, data and constraints
Configure, extend and integrate the platform to solve the customer's real problem
Write production Python and TypeScript that ships into customer environments
Feed what you learn in the field back to the core product and engineering teams
Run workshops and demos with technical and non-technical stakeholders
must_haves: {years}+ years building and shipping production software
Strong Python, with working knowledge of TypeScript
Experience working directly with customers or end users on technical delivery
Comfort with ambiguity: scoping and delivering from loosely defined problems
Able to explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical audiences
nice_to_haves: Willingness to travel to customer sites
